rubric.role_summary: Senior ASIC front-end design role developing and integrating high-performance RTL for AI hardware, from microarchitecture and synthesis through design closure and silicon bring-up.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior ASIC front-end design role developing and integrating high-performance RTL for AI hardware, from microarchitecture and synthesis through design closure and silicon bring-up.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent.
- 8+ years of RTL design experience.
- Experience in high-performance computing, GPU/CPU designs, machine learning, or related fields.
- Experience with networking protocols such as Ethernet, TCP/IP, or RDMA.
- Knowledge of high-speed interfaces such as PCIe or SerDes.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience with the FPGA development toolchain, including place and route, floor planning, and timing analysis.
- Experience managing an external ASIC vendor through a product development cycle.
- 8+ years of experience delivering complex, high-performance RTL designs.
- Experience with front-end chip integration and third-party IP integration.
- Track record of multiple successful silicon projects.
- Experience collaborating with external vendors.
- Networking stack experience including TCP/IP, RDMA, and Ethernet.
- Knowledge of PCIe, CPU interfaces, and SerDes technology.
- Working knowledge of Python and TCL scripting tools.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: United States (remote). This is the role's single location rule: candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
